goals.title: Secure the Bulgarian Alliance
goals.description: An agreement with Sofia can strengthen the southern front and give the coalition a partner between Serbia and the Ottoman Empire. Bulgaria must join through a negotiated political commitment.
goals.completed: BUL = { exists = yes is_subject = no OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } }

goals.title: The Route to Constantinople
goals.description: Our armies and workshops must be connected with the Ottoman Empire. With Bulgaria and the Ottomans in the alliance, secure the principal railway junctions from Berlin through Vienna, Budapest and Serbia to Sofia and Constantinople.
goals.completed: BUL = { exists = yes OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } TUR = { exists = yes OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } AUH = { exists = yes OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } 64 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes } 1051 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes } 43 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes } 107 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes } 108 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes } 48 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes } 1036 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes } 797 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes }

goals.title: A Separate Peace in the East
goals.description: A settlement with Russia would release forces for the remaining fronts and establish a new balance in Eastern Europe. The negotiations must produce an accepted treaty before the eastern campaign can be considered concluded.
goals.condition: The Treaty of Brest-Litovsk has been concluded.

goals.title: A Polish Kingdom under Our Protection
goals.description: The occupation of Russian Poland raises a political question as well as a military one. Establish a Polish state under the protection of the Central Powers, with a government able to exercise authority in Warsaw.
goals.completed: POL = { exists = yes controls_state = 10 OR = { is_subject_of = GER is_subject_of = AUH } }

goals.title: Force a Settlement in the West
goals.description: The alliance seeks a peace that will secure its position against France and Britain. Military successes must be converted into a settlement accepted by the opposing coalition, rather than another temporary pause in the fighting.
goals.condition: The Entente has accepted the Central Powers victory settlement.

goals.title: Bring Italy into the Entente
goals.description: Rome must decide whether the promises of the Entente outweigh its former commitments. Secure Italian membership through the negotiations and political decisions required by the Italian government.
goals.completed: ITA = { exists = yes is_subject = no OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } }

goals.title: Secure Romanian Cooperation
goals.description: Romanian participation can open another front against the Habsburg monarchy. Diplomatic assurances must lead to an agreed place for Bucharest in the alliance.
goals.completed: ROM = { exists = yes is_subject = no OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } }

goals.title: Recover Alsace-Lorraine
goals.description: The loss of Alsace-Lorraine in 1871 remains central to French war aims. Bring the disputed province under French control as part of the liberation of occupied territory.
goals.completed: FRA = { exists = yes OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } 28 = { is_controlled_by = FRA }
goals.available: FRA = { exists = yes OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } }

goals.title: Open the Dardanelles
goals.description: An Allied position at the Straits would threaten the Ottoman capital and improve communications with Russia. Secure the approaches through Thrace and Edirne, then take Constantinople.
goals.completed: NOT = { TUR = { OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } } 184 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes } 1036 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes } 797 = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_ally = yes }

goals.title: Honour the London Promises
goals.description: Italian intervention rests upon promises concerning the Habsburg frontier. Place South Tyrol, Trentino and Trieste under Italian control to give substance to those commitments.
goals.completed: ITA = { exists = yes OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } 39 = { is_controlled_by = ITA } 850 = { is_controlled_by = ITA } 736 = { is_controlled_by = ITA }
goals.available: ITA = { exists = yes OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } }

goals.title: Restore Belgian Sovereignty
goals.description: Belgium must emerge from the war free from occupation and foreign subordination. An end to the German campaign must be accompanied by the restoration of Belgian government over its homeland.
goals.completed: WW1_FG_german_settlement = yes BEL = { exists = yes is_subject = no } 6 = { is_controlled_by = BEL } 34 = { is_controlled_by = BEL }
goals.condition: Germany has accepted an armistice, capitulated, or ceased to exist; independent Belgium controls Flanders and Wallonia.

goals.title: Restore Serbia
goals.description: The Serbian homeland must be freed from occupation. Following the defeat or withdrawal of the Habsburg armies, Belgrade and eastern Serbia must be governed by an independent Serbian or Yugoslav state.
goals.completed: WW1_FG_habsburg_settlement = yes 107 = { controller = { exists = yes is_subject = no OR = { original_tag = SER original_tag = YUG } } } 108 = { controller = { exists = yes is_subject = no OR = { original_tag = SER original_tag = YUG } } }
goals.condition: A Habsburg defeat or the general armistice has ended the occupation; independent Serbia or Yugoslavia controls its homeland.

goals.title: Unite the Four Balkan Allies
goals.description: The agreement against Ottoman rule depends upon cooperation between Serbia, Bulgaria, Greece and Montenegro. Bring all four governments into the League before the campaign divides their interests.
goals.completed: SER = { exists = yes is_subject = no OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } BUL = { exists = yes is_subject = no OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } GRE = { exists = yes is_subject = no OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } MNT = { exists = yes is_subject = no OR = { tag = ROOT is_in_faction_with = ROOT } }

goals.title: End Ottoman Rule in Macedonia
goals.description: The League seeks to remove Ottoman authority from Macedonia. Secure the regions around Skopje and Salonika through the common campaign, leaving their final allocation to the peace negotiations.

goals.title: Conclude the Peace of London
goals.description: Military gains must become an agreed end to the war. Conclude the London settlement with the Ottoman Empire and bring the League’s campaign to a close.
goals.completed: custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = ww1_fg_london_signed_tt has_global_flag = treaty_of_london_1913 } NOT = { WW1_FG_at_war_with_ottomans = yes }
goals.condition: The 1913 Treaty of London is concluded and no League member remains at war with the Ottomans.
